Per-route illumination gates use measured relief as a shadow-risk proxy and require time-windowed replacement evidence.

site dossier carries the refreshed energy and illumination decisions

acceptance_criteria.description: Name the ephemeris or illumination source family, citation, local evidence path, checksum, and temporal coverage window.
Compute sunlit hours, expected generation Wh, dark-survival Wh, and margin for the selected route window.
Update the MoonBit energy and illumination assessments and add tests that prove Moonrobo remains blocked or becomes reviewable for cited reasons.

safety_gate: Do not allow Moonrobo simulation until power-window-json is ready, generated MoonBit evidence is current, and Moonrobo preconditions no longer block on power-window-evidence.
